    ∀ (u : Real),
      LE.le.{0} 0 u →
        (∀ (l j : Nat), LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (err l j)) u) →
          LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(Nat.clog 2 (List.length.{0} xs))) u) 1 →
            ∃ t,
              And (Eq.{1} (Bhola.algorithm xs err) (Option.some.{0} t))
                (∃ ps,
                  And (Eq.{1} (List.map.{0, 0} Prod.fst.{0, 0} ps) (Bhola.Tree.leaves t))
                    (And
                      (Eq.{1} (Bhola.Tree.eval t)
                        (List.sum.{0} (List.map.{0, 0} (fun p => HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} p.1 p.2) ps)))
                      (∀ (p : Prod.{0, 0} Real Real),
                        Membership.mem.{0, 0} ps p →
                          LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} p.2)
                            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Bhola.gamma (Nat.clog 2 (List.length.{0} xs)) u) (abs.{0} p.1)))))
